articles.title: Salmonellosis Outbreak in a Rottweiler Kennel Associated with Raw Meat-Based Diets

en.research_question: To characterize the clinical presentation, microbiological profile, and environmental spread of a Salmonella infection within a canine breeding facility.
en.study_design: A descriptive case report and outbreak investigation utilizing clinical observation, sample collection, and laboratory diagnostics.
en.population_setting: A Bulgarian Rottweiler breeding kennel comprising adult and post-partum dogs.
en.main_findings: Affected animals exhibited gastrointestinal symptoms and lethargy, with more severe presentations occurring in recently whelped females. Microbiological testing revealed extensive bacterial shedding among the dogs alongside contamination of their diet and surrounding surfaces. Full recovery followed the cessation of raw diet administration, implementation of targeted drug therapy, and thorough sanitation, while exposed humans remained uninfected.
en.public_health_relevance: The report highlights the cross-species transmission potential of pathogens found in unregulated raw animal feed. It advocates for enhanced feed traceability and biosecurity standards to mitigate health threats under a collaborative veterinary-human health approach.
en.limitations: The evaluation relies on observational data from a single facility without a comparative control cohort. Consequently, the observed outcomes may not reflect broader canine populations or different regional conditions.
en.gids_interpretation: This article contributes to the academic record of veterinary infectious disease events and diagnostic methodologies. Its documentation aids scholarly monitoring of dietary-related microbial risks in domestic animal settings.

articles.title: Transmission pathways and risk factors for sporadic salmonellosis and campylobacteriosis: a source attribution meta-analysis of European case-control studies.

en.research_question: What are the primary transmission routes and attributable sources for sporadic campylobacteriosis and salmonellosis across European populations?
en.study_design: A Bayesian meta-analytical framework was utilized to combine population attributable fractions extracted from multiple European case-control investigations spanning two decades.
en.population_setting: Participants comprised individuals diagnosed with sporadic infections alongside matched controls recruited from Western and Northern European healthcare settings.
en.main_findings: Dietary and aquatic exposures accounted for nearly fifty percent of infections, with poultry products representing the dominant reservoir for Campylobacter and both poultry and pork contributing substantially to Salmonella cases. Incorporating direct animal interactions raised the zoonotic contribution to approximately sixty percent, while environmental factors explained roughly ten percent. The remaining portion of cases correlated with international travel, preexisting medical conditions, pharmaceutical interventions, interpersonal contact, and workplace activities.
en.public_health_relevance: Identifying dominant reservoirs and exposure routes supports targeted prevention strategies and resource allocation for enteric pathogen control across European health systems.
en.limitations: The synthesis relies exclusively on aggregated data from previously published case-control investigations, which may introduce variability in how exposure categories were defined and reported across different regions.
en.gids_interpretation: This publication offers a synthesized overview of historical attribution patterns for two major bacterial enteritides, serving as a reference point for transmission ecology rather than reflecting active outbreak detection or real-time epidemiological tracking.

zh.research_question: 欧洲散发性空肠弯曲菌病与沙门氏菌病的主要传播途径及危险因素是什么？
zh.study_design: 该研究采用贝叶斯框架下的荟萃分析方法，整合了多项欧洲病例对照研究的归因分数数据。
zh.population_setting: 研究对象涵盖西欧与北欧国家在二零零零年至二零二一年间开展的病例对照试验中的患者与健康对照者。
zh.main_findings: 食物与水源传播约占病例总数的一半，其中家禽产品是主要传染源。结合动物接触因素后，约六成感染可归因于人畜共患途径。其余四分之一病例则与旅行史、基础疾病用药、人际传播及职业暴露相关。
zh.public_health_relevance: 该分析通过量化不同传播途径的贡献比例，为区域性疾病防控重点提供依据。
zh.limitations: 数据仅来源于西欧和北欧地区，可能无法代表其他地理区域的流行特征。此外，纳入的研究时间跨度较长，可能难以反映近期的流行病学变化。
zh.gids_interpretation: 该文献提供了特定区域内历史病原体归因模式的背景信息，侧重于学术综述而非实时监测信号评估。

articles.title: Comprehensive review of salmonellosis: current status of the disease and future perspectives

en.research_question: What are the prevailing epidemiological characteristics, diagnostic methodologies, and management frameworks for salmonellosis within Saudi Arabia?
en.study_design: The publication functions as a peer-reviewed comprehensive review article that synthesizes existing literature on the topic.
en.population_setting: The analysis focuses on the national population of Saudi Arabia, with particular attention to healthcare accessibility in remote districts.
en.main_findings: Clinical presentations typically feature gastrointestinal distress alongside systemic fever, while pathogen identification depends on both conventional and genetic laboratory assays. Current mitigation strategies rely on immunization initiatives, dietary safety standards, and community awareness programs. Ongoing obstacles encompass drug-resistant bacterial strains, inadequate medical infrastructure in isolated regions, and incomplete case documentation, which collectively drive proposals for expanded monitoring networks and stricter regulatory oversight.
en.public_health_relevance: The manuscript underscores the considerable disease burden in the region and delineates strategic interventions aimed at curbing transmission through coordinated policy adjustments and resource allocation.
en.limitations: The authors explicitly note that fragmented case reporting and constrained medical facilities in peripheral areas impede effective disease management.
en.gids_interpretation: This peer-reviewed synthesis was released in October 2024 and is indexed under food safety and infectious disease monitoring categories. It provides a consolidated overview of regional health priorities rather than generating new empirical datasets.

zh.research_question: 本文旨在系统梳理沙门氏菌病的当前流行与临床现状，并探讨未来的防控与管理策略。
zh.study_design: 该文献属于针对特定传染病的综合性学术综述，未包含原始队列观察或实验干预设计。
zh.population_setting: 研究内容主要围绕沙特阿拉伯地区的公共卫生环境与疾病分布展开。
zh.main_findings: 文章概述了该病的典型临床症状与实验室结合分子技术的诊断流程，指出疫苗接种、食品安全规范及健康教育是现有防控核心。同时强调抗菌药物耐药性、基层医疗资源短缺及病例报告不全构成主要管理瓶颈，并建议通过强化监测网络与跨部门协作来缓解疾病负担。
zh.public_health_relevance: 该综述直接回应区域传染病控制需求，为优化食品安全监管与公共卫生资源配置提供理论依据。
zh.limitations: 受综述体裁限制，本研究缺乏一手流行病学数据支撑；文中亦明确指出抗菌药物耐药性、偏远地区医疗条件受限以及潜在病例漏报可能削弱整体评估的完整性。
zh.gids_interpretation: 作为区域性疾病现状的学术梳理，该文献可为相关主题检索与背景知识构建提供参考，但不反映实时疫情监测动态。

articles.title: Seasonal Mathematical Model of Salmonellosis Transmission and the Role of Contaminated Environments and Food Products

zh.research_question: 本研究旨在构建数学模型，以探究沙门氏菌在人类、牲畜及受污染环境中的季节性传播动态，并识别决定疾病持续或消亡的关键参数。
zh.study_design: 该研究采用非自主数学建模方法，结合拉丁超立方抽样与最小二乘法对历史暴发数据进行参数校准，并利用谱半径理论推导基本再生数及阈值条件。
zh.population_setting: 模型包含人类、牛群以及环境与食品源中的细菌群体，参数估计基于沙特阿拉伯2018至2021年间的沙门氏菌暴发记录。
zh.main_findings: 估算的基本再生数为0.606，模型对累计与新发病例数据的拟合度较高，提示疾病具备可控潜力。模拟表明当再生数低于1时疾病趋于消亡，高于1时则呈现地方性流行特征。敏感性分析指出死亡率、感染率及衰减率对传播结果具有决定性影响。
zh.public_health_relevance: 该计算框架通过量化不同传播路径与关键参数的作用，为解析沙门氏菌的传播机制提供了理论依据，有助于评估各类干预策略对改变传播阈值的潜在贡献。
zh.limitations: 研究性质为理论推演与数值模拟，其结论高度依赖单一区域的历史数据输入及预设的种群假设，尚未纳入实地验证或复杂的社会行为变量。
zh.gids_interpretation: 作为计算流行病学文献，该成果侧重于揭示季节波动与环境媒介对传播网络的结构化影响，可为相关监测体系的理论参数设定提供学术参考，但不构成对当前实时疫情态势的直接印证。
